info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Expert Sales Support API
info.description: The Product Expert Sales Support API enables businesses to streamline their sales interactions by providing access to expert product knowledge and support. This API allows sales teams to quickly submit inquiries and receive expert advice on product features and benefits, enhancing the customer experience. Typical consumers of this API include sales representatives and customer support teams who require immediate access to specialized knowledge to assist customers effectively. Leveraging this API can lead to improved sales outcomes and increased customer satisfaction.

post.summary: Request expert sales support for a product.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a request for expert sales support regarding a specific product. The request will be handled by our dedicated sales experts who will provide tailored assistance based on the user's needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit product expert sales support inquiries. The data should include relevant details about the product and the nature of the sales support required.

201.description: Resource successfully created for expert sales support.
